# Curriculum and lesson files

Before changing curriculum specs or lesson content:

- Read `docs/curriculum-specs/README.md`, `docs/curriculum-specs/00-conventions.md`, and the phase spec for the topic.
- Confirm the phase spec exists by listing `docs/curriculum-specs/`. If it does not, stop and say so.
- Work on one topic at a time and follow the spec's template, numbers, and diagram rules.
- Do not overwrite authored lessons or change types in `artifacts/system-design-academy/src/types/` without explaining why.
- Update the curriculum status list, `README.md`, and `PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md` when a change adds or removes specs, routes, or content.
